formation.note: Date of the expression of interest, used as a lower bound for the KLOE-2 collaboration formation.
formation.quote: Expression of interest for the continuation of the KLOE physics program at DAΦNE upgraded in luminosity and in energy, March 31, 2006

intervals.label: DAΦNE data taking (KLOE-2)
intervals.note: Data taking concluded on 30 March 2018, with 5.5 fb^-1 acquired by KLOE-2 (about 8 fb^-1 with KLOE).
intervals.quote: then continued with KLOE-2 since November 2014

intervals.label: data taking ended
intervals.note: Analyses of KLOE-2 data are ongoing (CERN Courier).
intervals.quote: On 30 March the KLOE-2 experiment concluded its data-taking campaign

summary.plain: The roughly 60-strong collaboration that upgraded the KLOE detector and ran KLOE-2 at Frascati's DAΦNE from 2014 to 2018.
summary.technical: KLOE-2 Collaboration: roughly 60 members (CERN Courier, 2018); authors of the Inner Tracker TDR from Bari, Calabria, Cosenza, Frascati and other institutes.
